card.name: Ending words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: The last piece of PATIENT (the S) or a linking word like WHEN or WAS in ALL-CAPS boxed warning text, just before a drug or condition phrase. Also seen on a few oddly split words such as 'non' in 'nonverbally'.

modes.label: Plural PATIENTS in caps
modes.description: The final S of PATIENTS in an all-caps boxed warning, before a condition or drug name.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK FOR HEPATIC DECOMPENSATION IN PATIENT<<S>> WITH CHRONIC HEPATIT

modes.label: Linking verb in caps
modes.description: A linking word such as WHEN or WAS in an all-caps warning sentence, before a drug or treatment phrase.
modes.example: UTERINE RUPTURE HAS BEEN REPORTED WHEN MISOPROSTOL<< WAS>> ADMINISTERED IN PREGNANT

modes.label: Odd split in general text
modes.description: A word start or bracket in ordinary web text, such as 'non' before 'verbally' or '(' before an abbreviation.
modes.example: Harry Potter tried to cast the charm<< non>>verbally and wandlessly to retrieve his

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated to each other.
card.plain: It fires on the end of PATIENTS or on small linking words in capitalized boxed warnings, right before the drug or condition is named.
